modern: I am made up of the formal and the material; and neither of them will perish into non-existence, just as neither of them came into existence out of non-existence. Every part of me, then, will be changed into some part of the universe, and that again will change into another part of the universe, and so on for ever. And as a consequence of such change I too exist, and those who gave me life, and so on for ever in the other direction. For nothing prevents us from saying so, even if the universe is governed according to fixed periods of revolution.
original: I am composed of the formal and the material; and neither of them will perish into non-existence, as neither of them came into existence out of non-existence. Every part of me then will be reduced by change into some part of the universe, and that again will change into another part of the universe, and so on forever. And by consequence of such a change I too exist, and those who begot me, and so on forever in the other direction. For nothing hinders us from saying so, even if the universe is administered according to definite periods [of revolution].
